analysis_metadata.title: EMSR927 Independent Disaster-Impact Spatial Consistency Analysis
analysis_metadata.analysis_type: Descriptive spatial overlap / consistency analysis (NOT flood detection accuracy validation)
analysis_metadata.scientific_notice: EMSR927 observed-event polygons used in this comparison represent mapped mass movement/debris-flow impact associated with the Trishuli GLOF. FloodSpaceAI V3 models potential surface-water inundation. Because these products have different target definitions, direct precision, recall, IoU and F1 values are not measures of FloodSpaceAI flood-water detection accuracy.
analysis_metadata.target_model: FloodSpaceAI V3 Modelled Potential Surface-Water Inundation
analysis_metadata.provenance_statement: EMSR927 was evaluated strictly as an independent post-hoc checking reference. It was NOT used as an input to Sentinel-1 or Sentinel-2 processing, flood candidate generation, OSM asset impact analysis, road connectivity analysis, or AI copilot evidence.

target_definition_comparison.floodspace_ai_target: Potential surface-water inundation (smooth water specular radar attenuation & optical NDWI rise)
target_definition_comparison.emsr927_target: 6-Mass Movement / Landslide / Debris Flow (total geomorphological disturbance swath including dry boulder wash and hill scars)
target_definition_comparison.methodological_consequence: Target mismatch: Direct geometric comparison yields an overlap of 10.93 ha. The 45.24% candidate overlap ratio represents spatial consistency with the CEMS disaster-impact footprint, while the 1.02% recall and 1.01% IoU reflect target-definition divergence, not flood model failure.

reference_provenance.service: Copernicus Emergency Management Service (CEMS) Rapid Mapping
reference_provenance.source_authority: European Commission / DG ECHO / Copernicus EMS
reference_provenance.reference_acquisition_info: VHR optical photo-interpretation (Pléiades / WorldView) acquired post-event

common_aoi.spatial_overlap_description: Trishuli river corridor overlap with CEMS Rapid Mapping AOI03 (Syapru Besi) and AOI05 (Trishuli Valley)

spatial_overlap_with_emsr927_disaster_im.interpretation_warning: These metrics denote spatial overlap with the EMSR927 mapped disaster-impact footprint. They MUST NOT be interpreted as flood-water detection accuracy.
